findings.message: Detected 2 matching img entries with the same source/start/duration.
findings.fixHint: Avoid duplicated media nodes that can be discovered twice during compilation.

findings.message: <audio id="bgm"> has src but no data-start. HyperFrames cannot own playback for untimed media, so preview and render behavior can diverge.
findings.fixHint: Add data-start="0" (or the intended start time) and data-duration if the clip should stop before the source ends.

findings.message: GSAP tween uses `repeat: -1` (infinite), but the composition declares a finite 56s window. HyperFrames clips deterministic seeking and export to that explicit duration.
findings.fixHint: Keep the explicit finite composition `data-duration`. Use a finite repeat count only when the loop itself must end before the composition does.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 384 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: <section id="scene-0"> has timing attributes but no class="clip". The runtime still hides it outside its time range, but Studio and the GSAP clip-ownership rules use .clip to recognise a clip, so leaving it off makes the element harder to edit and to lint.
findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.

findings.message: <section id="scene-0"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section id="scene-0"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
